name: qkd_ctrl_pc_obs_s7c
slot_change_request: KVCTRL core_s7 child of the c1 wires-parent qkd_ctrl_pc_host_static (247.512 x 378 controller slot). Obs: S = sched seams (po / physical_context / static columns) and the commit / fault registers back to sched, N = native commit pins + clock.

job.purpose: KVCTRL core_s7 (lead Q-KV decision 2026-10-17): core_s6w CLOSED TT +4.34 / FF +10.33 but native audit FAIL (R 265.4: one hclk root of 13.8k sinks over 116.6 x 216 um measured ~275 ps TT insertion; launch 420.6 on 216 pins, capture 401.5 on 175 pins incl. ~155 ps of hold-ECO IO padding). The core is split into three hardened children with short roots (target R <= 170), every pin flop-first: qkd_ctrl_pc_sched (u_ctl, tag queue, raw check, arbiter, W/E pin flops, KV drain / idle_hbm), qkd_ctrl_pc_cdc_child (u_ecdc both clocks + core-clock intake / intake check / er / core drain / idle_core / static completion crossing, with pin registers on the u_ctl credit and the embedding return and output registers on the down FIFO), qkd_ctrl_pc_obs_child (native write observer behind input pin registers + native commit pin registers). Priced vs core_s6: static embed command +1 hclk, embedding return +1 hclk, u_ctl credit +1 hclk, native commit observation +1 hclk; KV read/write traffic 0 edges. Obs: S = sched seams (po / physical_context / static columns) and the commit / fault registers back to sched, N = native commit pins + clock. s7c (coordinator 0co CHANGES 10-17 ~09:35: obs_s7 S-face seam pin-flop band solid red over the whole 108-um edge): 108 x 81, the 347-b context_word seam moved to the E face (po + controls stay on S), clock centred on N.
